# Claude Daily Memory

Claude Daily Memory is open-source, privacy-first long-term memory for Claude Code.

Canonical website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/
Source repository: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory
License: Apache-2.0
Language: Python 3.11+

Key properties:
- aggregates safe activity across multiple Claude Code terminals and projects;
- never reads raw Claude Code transcripts;
- includes curated Markdown artifacts only;
- scans artifacts and final digests for secrets before network access;
- fails closed on uncertainty or errors;
- optionally exports with official Google Drive and Docs APIs using drive.file;
- stores refresh tokens in the operating-system Secret Service;
- supports a standard Google Doc as a NotebookLM Drive source;
- excludes Gmail content from daily memory;
- only supports reversible Gmail moves to Trash, never permanent deletion;
- provides an explicit-text-only bridge to Gemini.

Primary documentation:
- README: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/blob/main/README.md
- Security: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Gmail rules: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory/blob/main/docs/GMAIL.md
